description: This class includes the provision of short-stay accommodation for visitors.
includes: provision of accommodation in hotels, resort hotels, suite hotels, motels
provision of accommodation in bed and breakfast establishments
provision of accommodation in youth hostels and mountain refuges
provision of accommodation in holiday homes and cottages
excludes: provision of homes and furnished or unfurnished flats for longer-term use, see 6810
provision of accommodation in student residences and dormitories, see 5590
